applies_why: The judge text addresses a collision between the defender's and challenger's chains over Acts 2:30 and evaluates whether either chain forces the other.
rule_words: When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.
room: The phrase 'weighs chain against chain by footing': I weighed whether the judge compared the chains as wholes or merely tallied individual verses; the judge compared the chains as wholes.
why: The judge's conclusion treats the matter as underdetermined by the two chains rather than by any verse's failure to state the contrary, so it obeys K-C.
